description:
You are an oral and maxillofacial surgeon preparing a comprehensive pre-operative bilateral symmetry workup for a patient presenting with suspected facial asymmetry who is being evaluated for orthognathic surgery. The degree and distribution of asymmetry must be documented across all craniofacial regions. A CT imaging series is already loaded in InVesalius 3. The surgical assessment form is at /home/ga/Documents/asymmetry_study/assessment_form.txt.

Complete a full bilateral craniofacial asymmetry analysis:
1. Create a bone segmentation mask using appropriate Hounsfield thresholds for craniofacial bone (cortical and cancellous bone together is acceptable; bone is typically above 226 HU).
2. Generate the 3D bone surface mesh.
3. Place at least 12 linear measurements following a bilateral protocol — you MUST include corresponding measurements on BOTH the left AND right sides of the skull and face at symmetric anatomical locations. This means at minimum 4 bilateral pairs (left + right at 4 anatomical sites) plus 4 midline/overall cranial measurements. Example bilateral pairs: left temporal width + right temporal width; left orbital width + right orbital width; left mastoid process height + right mastoid process height; left parietal width + right parietal width. Example midline measurements: maximum cranial length, maximum cranial breadth, cranial height, minimum frontal breadth.
4. Export the 3D bone surface as a binary STL file to /home/ga/Documents/asymmetry_study/skull_model.stl
5. Capture and save screenshots from FIVE standard anatomical orientations of the 3D surface:
   - Anterior view → /home/ga/Documents/asymmetry_study/anterior_view.png
   - Left lateral view → /home/ga/Documents/asymmetry_study/left_lateral.png
   - Right lateral view → /home/ga/Documents/asymmetry_study/right_lateral.png
   - Superior (top-down) view → /home/ga/Documents/asymmetry_study/superior_view.png
   - Posterior (back) view → /home/ga/Documents/asymmetry_study/posterior_view.png
6. Save the complete InVesalius project (bone mask + 3D surface + all 12+ measurements) to /home/ga/Documents/asymmetry_study/asymmetry_analysis.inv3
